∀ (K : ℕ) (L σ ε R γ Δ : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    0 < ε →
      0 ≤ R →
        0 < γ →
          L * γ * σ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 4 →
            ∀ (a b D F : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (I : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
              (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ b k) →
                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                    F (k + 1) ≤
                      F k - γ / 2 * a k - γ / 2 * (1 - L * γ) * b k + γ * L ^ 2 / 2 * D k + γ ^ 2 * L / 2 * σ ^ 2) →
                  F 0 - F K ≤ Δ →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ), I k ⊆ Finset.Ico (p k) k) →
                      (∀ (k : ℕ), p k ≤ k) →
                        (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑k - ↑(p k) ≤ R) →
                          (∀ (k : ℕ), D k ≤ 2 * γ ^ 2 * ↑(I k).card * (∑ i ∈ I k, b i + σ ^ 2)) →
                            (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                L * γ * R * a k ≤ L * γ * R * (1 + L * γ * R) * b k + (1 + L * γ * R) * L ^ 2 * D k) →
                              (R = 0 → ∀ (k : ℕ), a k = b k) →
                                ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, a k +
                                      (1 - L * γ - 2 * (L * γ * R) ^ 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, b k ≤
                                    2 * Δ / γ + ↑K * ε * (L * γ * σ ^ 2 / ε) * (1 + 2 * (L * γ * R)) ∧
                                  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, a k ≤
                                    (1 + L * γ * R) * (1 + 2 * (L * γ * R)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, b k +
                                      2 * (1 + L * γ * R) * (↑K * ε) * (L * γ * σ ^ 2 / ε)

declarations.type_text:
∀ (K : ℕ) (L σ ε R Rt γ Δ : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    0 < ε →
      0 ≤ R →
        R + 1 ≤ Rt →
          0 ≤ Δ →
            0 < γ →
              L * γ * Rt ≤ 1 / 2 →
                L * γ * σ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 4 →
                  L * γ * Rt = 1 / 2 ∨ L * γ * σ ^ 2 = ε / 4 →
                    ∀ (a b D F : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (I : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
                      (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ b k) →
                        (∀ (k : ℕ),
                            F (k + 1) ≤
                              F k - γ / 2 * a k - γ / 2 * (1 - L * γ) * b k + γ * L ^ 2 / 2 * D k +
                                γ ^ 2 * L / 2 * σ ^ 2) →
                          F 0 - F K ≤ Δ →
                            (∀ (k : ℕ), I k ⊆ Finset.Ico (p k) k) →
                              (∀ (k : ℕ), p k ≤ k) →
                                (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑k - ↑(p k) ≤ R) →
                                  (∀ (k : ℕ), D k ≤ 2 * γ ^ 2 * ↑(I k).card * (∑ i ∈ I k, b i + σ ^ 2)) →
                                    (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                        L * γ * R * a k ≤
                                          L * γ * R * (1 + L * γ * R) * b k + (1 + L * γ * R) * L ^ 2 * D k) →
                                      (R = 0 → ∀ (k : ℕ), a k = b k) →
                                        4 * Rt * L * Δ / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * Δ / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                                          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, a k ≤ ↑K * ε

  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (B M : ℕ) (δ : ℕ → ℕ) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 < B →
          0 < M →
            (∀ (b : ℕ), δ b ≤ b ∧ M * δ b < B) →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
                LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
                  LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω
                      (↑μ) f g σ →
                    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k η => η k) ↑μ ↑P →
                      ∀ (K : ℕ),
                        4 * (↑B + ↑M - 1) * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.asyncTree M δ).IsMainBranch
                              OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch ∧
                            (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                  (fun η =>
                                    ‖gradient f
                                          ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.asyncTree M δ).vertex
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.asyncStep L σ ε B M) x0 g η
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                      2)
                                  ↑P) ∧
                              1 / ↑K *
                                  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                    ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                      ‖gradient f
                                            ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.asyncTree M δ).vertex
                                              (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.asyncStep L σ ε B M) x0 g η
                                              (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                        2 ∂↑P ≤
                                ε

∀ (src : ℕ → ℕ) (cont : ℕ → Bool),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), src k ≤ k) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), cont k = true → 0 < k ∧ src k = src (k - 1)) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        ∃ a,
          src k ≤ a ∧
            a ≤ k ∧
              (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).repr (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainAux src cont k) =
                  (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).repr (2 * src k) +
                    Multiset.map (fun i => 2 * i) (Finset.Ico a k).val ∧
                (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).depth
                      (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainAux src cont k) =
                    src k + (k - a) ∧
                  2 * src k ∈
                    (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).ancestors
                      (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainAux src cont k)

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Public),
  q.tree.WellFormed →
    q.tree.IsMainBranch q.branch →
      ∀ (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
        (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d),
        Measurable (Function.uncurry g) →
          ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d → ℝ) (ε : ℝ),
            (∀ (k : ℕ),
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun η => ‖gradient f (q.tree.vertex q.gamma q.x0 g η (q.branch k))‖ ^ 2) ↑P) →
              1 / ↑(q.K + 1) *
                    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (q.K + 1),
                      ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω), ‖gradient f (q.tree.vertex q.gamma q.x0 g η (q.branch k))‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P ≤
                  ε →
                (Measurable fun z =>
                    OracleTemplate.execute (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.gradientOracle P g)
                      (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.birch q) (fun x => q.branch q.K) z.1 z.2) ∧
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun z =>
                        ‖gradient f
                              (OracleTemplate.execute (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.gradientOracle P g)
                                (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.birch q) (fun x => q.branch q.K) z.1 z.2)‖ ^
                          2)
                      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (q.K + 1))).toMeasure.prod ↑P) ∧
                    ∫ (z : Fin (q.K + 1) × (ℕ → Ω)),
                        ‖gradient f
                              (OracleTemplate.execute (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.gradientOracle P g)
                                (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.birch q) (fun x => q.branch q.K) z.1 z.2)‖ ^
                          2 ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (q.K + 1))).toMeasure.prod ↑P ≤
                      ε

  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (n s : ℕ) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 < s →
          s ≤ n →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g σ →
                  LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k η => η k) ↑μ ↑P →
                    ∀ (K : ℕ),
                      8 * ↑n ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / (↑s * ε) + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                        (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).IsMainBranch
                            OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch ∧
                          (∀ (k : ℕ),
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun η =>
                                  ‖gradient f
                                        ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).vertex
                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleStep L σ ε n s) x0 g η
                                          (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                    2)
                                ↑P) ∧
                            1 / ↑K *
                                ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                  ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                    ‖gradient f
                                          ((OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleTree n s).vertex
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.cycleStep L σ ε n s) x0 g η
                                            (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainBranch k))‖ ^
                                      2 ∂↑P ≤
                              ε

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ ε R Rt lower : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 ≤ R →
          R + 1 ≤ Rt →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g σ →
                  (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                    T.WellFormed →
                      T.IsMainBranch m →
                        LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainStep L σ ε Rt)
                            x0 g ↑P →
                          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                              ∀ (K : ℕ),
                                4 * Rt * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                                  (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                        (fun η =>
                                          ‖gradient f
                                                (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainStep L σ ε Rt) x0 g η
                                                  (m k))‖ ^
                                            2)
                                        ↑P) ∧
                                    1 / ↑K *
                                        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                          ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                            ‖gradient f
                                                  (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainStep L σ ε Rt) x0 g η
                                                    (m k))‖ ^
                                              2 ∂↑P ≤
                                      ε
